'''Mirax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] who was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] worker at the [[Shipyard/Legends|Shipyards]] of [[Gwori]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Mirax toiled as an enslaved worker on the planet [[Gwori]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] until he held the position of foreman. As [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] lead the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to [[Battle of Gwori|battle]] the Separatists and free the slaves, Mirax, along with slaves were free and decided to leave Gwori. They were later employed as laborers for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] defense industry.
